provenance.quote: Adult patients ≥ 18 y old who met the following criteria were included in our analysis
admission to the medical ICU or surgical/trauma ICU, need for mechanical ventilation, and a respiratory therapy consult to obtain PL measurements
admission to the medical ICU or surgical/trauma ICU

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS status not explicitly reported; study population includes hypoxemic respiratory failure, some may have ARDS. Timing from intubation to PL measurement is 16h (<48h). Target expiratory PL 0-6 cm H2O; inspiratory PL limit <20; direct method.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap with any COHORTS.md cluster. Single centre (University of Virginia Medical Center, Charlottesville, Virginia), enrolment April 2019–July 2020, no trial registration; no match to epvent1/epvent2 (different trials and centres), mannheim_boesing (Mannheim), mgh_lung_rescue (MGH, enrolment ended July 2017), or angers (Angers, France). Pirrone_2016 refuted cluster also does not match (different institution and earlier period).
unclear_items: design.randomised: coded false; retrospective quality-improvement analysis with no randomisation described.
intervention.peep_titration_target.titration_frequency: not reported whether PEEP was re-titrated after the initial PL-guided adjustment.
outcomes: ventilator-free days definition (window, handling of death) not reported; recorded with timepoint.type not_reported.

mortality timepoint: paper reports 'overall ICU mortality' and 'died within 28 d after ICU admission'; coded as fixed_day 28, but ICU mortality at discharge vs 28-day mortality is not fully disambiguated.
paired_effects for SpO2/FIO2 at 48/72/96 h: arm_label_a left null because those timepoints have no arm label; only baseline and 24 h map to defined conditions.
hemodynamics vasoactive drug paired test: Table 2 gives P = .53 without naming the test; McNemar assumed from the Statistical Analysis section.
Fig. 4 caption text layer shows '‡P = .001' while the rendered image shows '‡P <.001' for Baseline vs 72 h; recorded p_value_verbatim '<.001' per image.
feasibility.n_placement_attempted/n_placement_successful: derived from N = 20 analysed with no explicit placement-failure reporting.
data_only_in_figure: SpO2/FIO2 distributions at 24, 48, 72, 96 h (Fig. 4) — only medians/IQRs for baseline and 24 h given in text; later timepoints partly in text but full distributions in figure only
extraction_flags.general_notes: Retrospective single-centre before/after quality-improvement analysis; the 'comparison' is within-patient before vs after PL-guided adjustment. Supplementary materials (FIO2/PL table, contraindication list) not available in this PDF. Two PL measurement configurations used (Hamilton G5 ventilator in 15/20; bedside monitor with disposable transducer in the remainder).
